news.title: Crypto's second U.S. lobbying front — tax policy — sees industry push on mining, staking
news.summary: The crypto sector's leading U.S. advocacy groups asked the U.S. House's tax committee to advance a bill to clarify treatment of assets from mining and staking.

news.title: Ethereum Foundation talent exodus sparks fresh debate over leadership
news.summary: The Ethereum community is once again debating the future of the foundation after co-executive director Hsiao-Wei Wang announced she would step down.
